description: This file is a C header file defining the exported API functions for the Dslh Objco Table component within the DSL Home Model Implementation (DSLH). It declares functions for creating, removing, enrolling, initializing, and resetting an Objco Table object, but does not include function implementations or other code logic.

methods.name: DslhCreateObjcoTable
methods.description: Creates a new Objco Table object with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: DslhObjcoTableCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Objco Table object with specified contexts.

methods.name: DslhObjcoTableRemove
methods.description: Removes an existing Objco Table object.

methods.name: DslhObjcoTableEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Objco Table.

methods.name: DslhObjcoTableReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Objco Table object.
